human_correction: The food visual in question was generated by the system rather than being a user-specified named real-world menu item requiring recovery of a pre-existing canonical dish identity.
root_cause: The semantic-identity gate was over-applied. It treated a generated generic food visual as if it were a real named product with authoritative upstream dish metadata, then incorrectly requested the user to supply a dish name, protein, and cooking method.

correct_rule.named_real_product_or_named_menu_item: Require a verified semantic identity contract before making specific dish/product claims.
correct_rule.generated_generic_food_visual_without_na: Do not invent or demand a canonical dish identity. Evaluate commercial quality using visual plausibility, appetite, category-level ingredient legibility, art direction, typography, hierarchy, material realism, production precision, and absence of misleading specific claims.
correct_rule.generated_visual_later_assigned_to_named: Require the name/ingredient/cooking-method facts from the actual brief or authoritative product source at that later point; do not infer them from pixels.
